name: GitHub Cards
description: Turns signed GitHub webhooks into one live card per pull request or issue, with reviews, comments and CI in its thread.

settings_schema.header: Point a GitHub org or repository webhook at https://<your Mattermost>/plugins/com.scaleupconsulting.githubcards/webhook with content type application/json and the secret set below. Deliveries without a valid X-Hub-Signature-256 are refused.

settings.help_text: One line per GitHub org or user that owns the repositories: `org = secret`. Each secret must be at least 16 characters and match the webhook's secret on GitHub.

One line per destination: `org -> team/channel` or `org/repo -> team/channel`, using the names in the channel URL. A repository's own lines win over its org's lines. Options after the channel: `events=pull_request,pull_request_review,pull_request_review_comment,issue_comment,issues,workflow_run,push` (default all) and `bots=include` to post comments from bot accounts (default: their comments are left out). Lines starting with # are ignored. The plugin will not start while a line is malformed or names a channel that does not exist.
